note: The name-availability endpoint always answers HTTP 200; an unusable name is carried in `reason`, never a 4xx. Every FORMAT refusal collapses to reason=invalid, so this endpoint does NOT expose the TS refusal PRECEDENCE (forbidden_code_point vs too_long) that the two cross-length cases below distinguish -- both are `invalid` here. That precedence is gated where it is observable: the core workspace_name fixture (conversation-title-parity.json) and slice 2's PATCH admission fixture.

cases.name: a held key is taken regardless of spelling
an agent-home name does not occupy the regular namespace
one code point over the 64 cap is invalid
cross-length: 65-128 code points WITH a forbidden scalar (TS forbidden_code_point) is invalid
cross-length: over 128 code points WITH a forbidden scalar (TS too_long) is invalid
